en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a busy, narrow urban street lined with multi‑story historic buildings and shopfronts. Hanging shop signs and pedestrians in early 20th‑century clothing are visible. A church with a tower stands further down the street in the center background. At the top of the image, printed in red, are the words "Pécs" and "Király-utca." The reverse side is formatted as a divided postcard with printed heading "LEVELEZŐ-LAP" and handwritten Hungarian text, addressed to someone in Budapest.
